title: Junior Complaints & Compliance Specialist
description:
Complaints and Compliance Specialist
Location: Berlin (office first)
The team
The Complaints team sits within Operations and works every day to make sure merchants who run their businesses on SumUp get fair, fast, and compliant resolutions whenever something goes wrong with a payment. As payment volumes grow, so does the complexity of the cases the team handles, from delayed payouts to disputed chargebacks, and this role exists to build the specialist skills needed to resolve these cases with precision and care. Joining now means learning the mechanics of payment processing from the ground up, working closely with Risk, Engineering, and Finance, and helping shape how SumUp responds to some of its most sensitive merchant and regulatory moments.
What you'll do

Investigate and resolve merchant complaints tied to payment processing, including authorisations, settlements, payouts, and chargebacks
Dig into processor logs, payment gateways, and payout systems to find the root cause of each issue and document the findings clearly
Draft clear, compliant final responses to merchants that meet regulatory timelines and internal SLAs
Work closely with Payment Operations, Risk, Engineering, and Finance to unblock complex cases
Keep case documentation audit ready and flag emerging patterns or recurring issues to the wider team
Contribute to playbooks and knowledge base articles that help the team resolve future cases faster

You'll be great for this role if...

Foundational understanding of payment processing, covering authorisations, settlements, payouts, and basic chargebacks
Comfort working with a CRM or ticketing system, following SOPs, and keeping precise, audit ready documentation
Strong written communication skills, with the ability to draft clear, customer friendly responses under regulatory constraints</

title: Engineering Manager | Applied AI
description: We're looking for an Engineering Manager to own AI at one of the fastest-growing AI legal tech companies in Europe. Over 2,000 lawyers use JUPUS every day, and the AI behind it is already in production and already in front of customers. You'd own the team, the technical roadmap, and the standard everything gets built to. You'll report to our Head of Engineering and lead our AI team. This is a leadership role, not a senior engineering seat with a lead title. You won't be shipping features yourself, and that's deliberate- we want someone whose leverage comes from the team they build and the calls they make. Your Challenge and Opportunity in This Role Legal work is document-heavy, judgement-heavy, and almost untouched by AI. We've trained on over a million German court rulings and handled over a million cases, so the hard part isn't proving AI belongs here. The hard part is doing it well enough that a lawyer will put their professional judgement behind the output. Your job is to make that repeatable. The field throws up something new every week and most of it is noise. We need someone who can tell the difference, turn that judgement into a roadmap, and build a team that can actually deliver it. Tasks Leading the team Make the team better than you found it: hire, mentor, and raise the bar on what good looks like here. Your impact shows up in what they ship when you're not in the room. Set the engineering standard for AI work: evaluation, testing and observability, and a delivery rhythm that holds up when the pressure is on.

You come from the world of tax and legal advisory; but you've never been content with how things have always been done. You may have trained at a Big 4 firm, working across tax structuring, legal advisory, or consulting. title: Mobile Architect
description:

As a Solutions Architect for Mobile Development, you will be responsible to take the business requirements and turn that into a software design that can become a blueprint for the implementation team to follow. You will also be responsible to make sure that the implementation team follows the design and delivers the project as per the agreed designs.

• Minimum of 4 years of experience making important architecture & design decisions; such as data domain modeling, application of design patterns, & design using third-party components.

title: Manager, Advertising Review
description:
As a manager of Advertising Review, you will play a crucial role in upholding the integrity and regulatory compliance of all advertising and marketing materials. You will be responsible for overseeing and implementing advertising compliance policies, reviewing, and approving advertising materials, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure adherence to industry regulations.
This will require a self-motivated individual with strong critical-thinking and communication skills, who is proactive, adaptable to change and thrives in a fast paced and dynamic environment. Further, this individual must possess a deep understanding of the industry and the related financial products and services. This is a Remote position.
What You'll Do:

• Manage advertising compliance policies and procedures in alignment with FINRA, SEC, and other relevant regulations.

• Review and approve advertising and marketing materials to ensure compliance with industry guidelines and internal policies.

• Provide guidance and training to internal teams, including marketing, sales, and legal departments, on advertising compliance requirements.

• Stay current with changes in financial industry regulations and update compliance policies as needed.

• Collaborate with external legal counsel and regulatory agencies as necessary to address compliance issues and inquiries.

• Monitor and track advertising campaigns, keeping detailed records and documentation of compliance efforts.

• Conduct periodic audits and reviews to identify and rectify potential compliance violations.

• Manage and lead a team of compliance professionals, providing guidance, training, and performance evaluations.

• Collaborate with the company's legal and risk management departments to ensure consistency in compliance standards

• Prepare and submit necessary reports and compliance documentation to regulatory agencies.

What You Need to Have:

• Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university, preferably in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or related field

• A minimum of 5 years of experience in advertising compliance within the financial services industry, preferably at a broker/dealer firm.

• Series 7 and 24 required.

• Series 63 is required (or get within 3 months of start date)

• Strong knowledge of FINRA and SEC regulations, as well as industry best practices in advertising compliance.

• Exceptional attention to detail, analytical skills, and the ability to interpret complex regulatory requirements.

• Strong communication skills to work with advisors, vendors, and internal teams and the ability to collaborate across departments

• Leadership and team management experience.

• Proficiency in relevant software and compliance tools.

• Proven ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and adapt to a fast-paced and changing regulatory environment.

Compensation:
The base salary range for this role is $91,000-120,000, plus a competitive performance-based bonus. Base salary depends on a wide array of factors, including but not limited to skill set, years and depth of experience, certifications, and location. Salary range may also differ significantly due to geography and cost of labor considerations.

We invest heavily in growing your caseload through marketing, client matching, and a strong referral engine. What we need from you is a partner in that effort: someone who shows up consistently, runs excellent Meet & Greet sessions, builds strong therapeutic relationships, and keeps clients engaged in thoughtful treatment planning.
We do the heavy lifting on visibility and operations. You focus on delivering excellent clinical care and building a caseload that lasts.

Our clients book most often in the evening, so this posting is targeted specifically at therapists who can meet that demand.

• Required availability: 6 to 9 PM EST on weekdays.

• Weekend or daytime availability is a strong asset in addition to evening hours.

• 8 to 10 hours a week with the bulk of those hours concentrated in the evening window.

• Potential for schedule growth, based on your availability and our demand.

What We Handle, So You Don't Have To
Billing, scheduling, client intake admin, and back-office support are all covered. Our secure telehealth platform gives you one place to manage sessions and notes. Your time goes to clinical work and client relationships, not chasing paperwork.
Compensation
Our compensation model reflects clinical experience, tenure, client demand, market rates, and the full support that comes with practicing at Shift Collab . Your rate is part of a broader model that includes client referrals and matching, marketing, billing, scheduling, intake administration, technology, and ongoing practice support.
Why Therapists Stay

• A real community. Being 100% virtual doesn't mean practicing alone. Peer supervision, team meetings, and knowledge-sharing keep you connected.

• Your own professional presence. We help build your bio and visibility, with opportunities for some therapists to write, speak, or contribute their expertise publicly.

• Support for you, too. Wellness resources, peer support, regular touchpoints, and social events help you stay connected to the community.

Who Thrives Here
Therapists who:

• Approach the therapeutic relationship with engagement over acronyms

• Excel at Meet & Greet sessions and know how to turn a first conversation into a strong therapeutic match

• Take retention and treatment planning seriously so clients feel cared for and know where their therapy is going

• See caseload growth as a shared effort and are ready to actively partner on it

• Are available 6 to 9 PM EST on weekdays, ideally with some weekend availability too

• Want a long-term engagement, not a short-term gig

What You Bring

• Master's in Social Work or Counselling Psychology, registered as an MSW RSW or RP

• A minimum of 2 years of post-licensure experience

• Professional liability insurance

• Reliable internet and a secure, private workspace

• Strong virtual therapy skills and comfort with telehealth platforms

• Experience or certifications in the following are an asset: ADHD and neurodiversity, EMDR, Couples Therapy, Family Therapy, IFS, anxiety, work stress and burnout, and OCD

What Makes You a Strong Fit

• You have direct experience speaking with motivated property sellers and negotiating real estate transactions.

• You are confident handling objections and difficult conversations over the phone.

• You know how to balance relationship-building with performance-driven sales goals.

• You are highly organized and disciplined with follow-up.

• You thrive in a remote, results-oriented environment.

Required Experience & Skills
Must-Have

• Previous experience in Real Estate Wholesaling, Acquisitions, FSBO, Subject-To transactions, or Distressed Property Sales.

• Proven track record of getting motivated sellers under contract.

• Strong phone sales, rapport-building, and objection-handling skills.

• Experience negotiating real estate transactions and purchase agreements.

• Familiarity with ARV calculations, repair estimates, and wholesale deal analysis.

• Experience using CRM systems and managing sales pipelines.

• Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Self-motivated with the ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Nice-to-Have

About Welocalize 
Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
 
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 

ROLE OVERVIEW 
Welocalize is looking for a native-level Finnish speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client. 
It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device - a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 
Welocalize is looking for a native-level Finnish speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme. 
It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Finnish, and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it. 
If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 
 
MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 
Review pre-release AI model output in Finnish and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality - would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material.

title: DSP SW Engineer
description:
Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place!

E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are building a highly-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system that will fundamentally change the design, economics, manufacturing and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems.

We’re intentional, we’re unapologetically curious and we’re 100% committed to innovate space-based communications and deliver actionable intelligence that will expand global economies, protect space and our planet and enhance our overall quality of life.

This is a full time, exempt position, based out of our Santa Clara office.  The target base pay for this position is $100,000 - $200,000 annually.  The total compensation packaged will be determined by various factors such as your relevant job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. 
 
We are redefining how satellites are designed, manufactured and used-so we’re looking for candidates with passion, deep knowledge and direct experience on LEO satellite component development, design and in-orbit activities. If that’s your experience - then we’ll be immediately wow-ed.
 
E-Space is not currently able to provide employment sponsorship for candidates who do not hold work authorization for the location of this role.

Why E-Space is right for you:

As a member of our team, you will play a crucial role in driving our success.  Our team members have a strong sense of dedication and responsibility; this includes a strong commitment to our mission to create an entirely new suite of global capabilities to improve lives, business efficiencies and build a smarter planet. This means that there will be times when extra hours, including nights and weekends, may be needed to meet critical deadlines and mission goals.  In return, we offer a dynamic work environment with opportunities for professional growth and development and the chance to make a meaningful impact in a high-growth industry.  

We want you to make the most of your journey at E-Space. That’s why we support and invest in the physical, emotional and financial well-being of our team members and their families. Some of what you can expect when working at E-Space:

• An opportunity to really make a difference
• Sustainability at our core
• Fair and honest workplace
• Innovative thinking is encouraged
• Competitive salaries
• Continuous learning and development
• Health and wellness care options
• Financial solutions for the future
• Optional legal services (US only)
• Paid holidays
• Paid time off

title: Social Media and Email Marketing Specialist
description:
About the Role
This role owns social media and email marketing for a fintech wealth planning platform, sitting within the Marketing team and reporting to the Head of Marketing. You will shape how the brand shows up across every channel, turning each post and campaign send into a learning opportunity that drives real audience growth and engagement.
What You'll Do

• Manage brand social media channels across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, and TikTok, keeping content on-brand and on-calendar.

• Partner with external content creation agencies to brief, align, and deliver work on time.

• Build and maintain a content calendar that supports campaigns and key announcements.

• Engage daily by responding to comments, answering DMs, and starting real conversations with the audience.

• Spot trends quickly and translate them into on-brand content opportunities.

• Own the email marketing strategy in HubSpot, from planning through execution.

• Write and design newsletters that subscribers genuinely want to read.

• Run continuous experiments on subject lines, send times, formats, and segmentation to improve opens, clicks, and conversions.

• Track performance weekly, report clearly, and adjust strategy based on data.

What We're Looking For

• 1 to 2 years of experience in social media, email marketing, or digital marketing with measurable results.

• Demonstrated track record of growing audiences or improving campaign performance metrics through owned work.

• Hands-on experience managing at least one major social platform, including content posting, community engagement, and performance tracking.

• Strong writing skills with a natural instinct for brand voice and tone across social posts, email copy, and newsletters.

• Proficiency executing email campaigns in HubSpot or a comparable platform such as Mailchimp or Klaviyo.

• Experience designing and analyzing A/B tests on email campaigns.

• Comfort reading marketing performance data and translating it into clear, actionable insights.

• Experience coordinating with external agencies, content creators, or freelancers to deliver on-brand work on deadline.

• Background in fintech, personal finance, or consumer brand marketing is a plus.

• Familiarity with paid social advertising to complement organic strategy is a plus.

Compensation & Benefits
Salary range: $80,000 to $100,000 USD annually. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.
Location
This is a full-time, on-site role based in New York, NY, United States.

title: WPN Retail Relationship Dev Specialist

At Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast, you’ll collaborate with passionate teams to reimagine our iconic brands and create experiences that spark joy, connection, and community through the magic of play. This is your chance to shape legendary play that lasts a lifetime.

The Wizards Play Network (WPN) plays a key role in this mission - assisting retailers, nurturing active play communities, and delivering excellent player experiences.

The WPN Retail Development Representative takes charge of growing and sustaining the Wizards Play Network throughout a varied, multi-market region spanning APAC. This position handles partner onboarding, retailer relationship management, and market expansion work across multiple markets characterized by diverse languages, regulatory settings, and retail progression levels.

Based in Singapore, the role is at the operational hub of the region. It enables efficient travel connectivity, aligns timezones across the group, and is close to the region's most developed WPN market.

WPN Partner Onboarding & Retailer Support

• Lead the end-to-end onboarding process for new WPN retail partners across all seven markets

• Serve as the primary point of contact for existing WPN retailers, handling critical issues, product support queries, and account management

• Maintain accurate records of retailer status, tier, and engagement across the region

Wizards Play Network Development

• Develop and carry out Wizards Play Network growth plans, to drive store growth and develop the Southeast Asia region.

• Identify and prioritize new partner opportunities based on local market potential to help expand play and commercial availability across the region.

• Support in-store and community play programs to drive product velocity through the retail channel

• Track and report on regional Wizards Play Network metrics

Regional & Cross-Functional Coordination

• Coordinate with the wider APAC team to ensure consistent regional strategy and shared findings

• Liaise with global WPN, marketing, and product teams on regional programs, launches, and promotional calendars

• Provide market intelligence and on-the-ground insight to inform APAC-wide planning and headcount/coverage decisions

Travel & Market Presence

• Travel regularly within the region to visit retail partners, attend/support events, and assess market conditions directly

• Represent the company behind Magic: The Gathering and Dungeons & Dragons at regional trade shows, conventions, and retailer events as required

What You’ll Bring

• Experience in retail development, channel sales, account management, or distributor/partner management, ideally within gaming, hobby, toy, or FMCG retail

• Proven track record to manage a multi-market or multi-country portfolio independently

• Familiarity with the tabletop gaming, trading card game (TCG), or collectible hobby retail landscape

• Existing network of retail contacts in one or more of the covered markets

• Prior experience working within a global brand's regional field team, reporting to an offshore manager

• Strong cross-cultural interpersonal skills; comfortable working across markets with differing languages and business norms

• Willingness and ability to undertake frequent travel across APAC

title: Manager Onboarding Operations AMER
description:
About Remote

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge - navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.

With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.

We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.

 

If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

The position

This is an exciting time to join Remote and make a personal difference in the global employment space as a Manager, Onboarding Operations, joining our Onboarding team.

This role manages a high-volume, regionally aligned operations team supporting employee onboarding across multiple countries. The Manager is responsible for people leadership, delivery quality, compliance, operational performance and continuous improvement across the employee onboarding lifecycle.

The role also supports AI, Automation and Operational Excellence by identifying workflow improvements, enabling responsible adoption within the team and partnering with our Experts and Leads on implementation.

This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced people leader who enjoys solving complex operational problems, developing scalable processes and helping teams adopt more effective ways of working. To be successful, you will bring strong operational leadership, sound judgement and a commitment to high-quality employee and customer outcomes.

You will report to the Senior Manager, Onboarding Operations.

Requirements

• Demonstrated people-management experience in a high-volume operational environment.

• A people-first leader who builds trust, empowers others and takes accountability for team performance and outcomes.

• Experience developing scalable operational processes while maintaining high standards of quality, compliance and employee and customer experience.

• An understanding of employment and/or labour laws, benefits, payroll processes and employment contracts across multiple countries, or the ability to learn these quickly.

• Strong stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams and communicate clearly during complex or sensitive situations.

• Strong operational judgement, balancing compliance requirements, team capacity, service quality and scalable delivery.

• Comfortable using data to make decisions, monitor performance, identify risks and recommend improvements.

• Comfortable using AI and automation tools to improve productivity, service quality and operational consistency.

• Able to identify repetitive work and process friction that may be suitable for automation or AI-assisted workflows.

• Experience leading change and helping teams adopt new tools or ways of working; technical implementation experience is welcome but not essential.

• Able to partner effectively with technical, data or automation specialists to define operational requirements, test solutions and support adoption.

• Sound judgement in the responsible use of AI, including data privacy, security, compliance, accuracy and appropriate human oversight.

• Calm under pressure and able to hold difficult conversations, resolve conflict and escalate appropriately.

• Pragmatic, flexible and able to operate independently in a fast-paced, international and high-growth environment.

• International people operations or HR generalist experience would be well regarded.

• Writes and speaks fluent English; fluency in an additional language is a bonus

title: Director, New Business Sales
description:
About Portless

Portless is a tech-enabled supply chain business that helps DTC brands ship directly from Asia to customers worldwide in 5-9 days. We're transforming how ecommerce brands think about fulfillment by eliminating the traditional 60-90 day ocean freight model and replacing it with faster, more flexible, cash-flow friendly logistics.
We're venture backed and growing fast. Our customers include brands shipping everything from apparel to consumer electronics, and we operate in 55+ countries. We're on a mission to make global fulfillment as seamless as domestic shipping.
The Role
We're looking for a Director of New Business Sales to lead the team of AEs responsible for winning new logos at Portless .
You'll inherit a team of seven new business Account Executives selling into the SMB and Mid-Market segments, with ACVs most commonly associated with Enterprise deal values in other industries. These are real deals with real complexity: multiple stakeholders, operational diligence, and buyers who need to move physical product in order to go live with our solution. Your team owns those deals end-to-end, from qualified opportunity through implementation.
This is a leadership role, not a player-coach role. You won't carry a personal quota. You will be measured on whether your team hits its number, and on whether the people on it get better while they do it. That means recruiting and retaining talent others want to hire, building a high-performance and low-ego culture, coaching at a world-class level, and knowing when to put your own hands on a deal.
It's also a global role. Our fulfillment operations run out of Asia, and our customers are expanding into Europe, Australia, and the wider APAC region. You'll work directly with our teams on the ground in those markets and help your AEs run deal cycles across them. The time zones required to execute at a global scale demand flexibility beyond a traditional 9 to 5 and we're looking for someone who treats that as part of the opportunity rather than an inconvenience.
What You'll Do

• Recruit and retain outstanding sales talent. You'll own hiring for the new business team as we scale beyond seven AEs, build a bench before you need it, and keep your best people here and growing.

• Build a high-performance, low-ego culture where the team makes commitments, meets them, and holds each other to a standard which demands we all do the best work of our careers. You'll set the bar for what "on track" looks like and make missing it uncomfortable without making it personal.

• Coach at a world-class level through call reviews, deal reviews, and 1:1s. You'll use our "One Thing" coaching philosophy to give each AE focused, specific feedback that measurably improves their craft.

• Get into the deals that matter. You'll bring real deal sense to your team's highest-potential opportunities, joining calls, shaping strategy, engaging senior stakeholders, and helping close business without taking the deal away from the rep.

• Own the number. You'll forecast accurately, track leading indicators, and diagnose pipeline problems early enough to do something about them.

• Run deal cycles across regions. You'll partner directly with our team in Asia and support your AEs on opportunities in Europe, Australia, and APAC.

• Develop the playbook for how new business is won at Portless , refining discovery, business case development, and competitive positioning as we scale.

• Partner cross-functionally with BDRs on target account strategy and handoff quality, with Marketing on messaging, with Onboarding and Client Success on customer transitions, and with RevOps on the systems that make the team faster.

• Maintain CRM discipline across the team, with accurate forecasting, clean deal stages, and activity logging in HubSpot.
What We're Looking For
Must-haves:

• 3+ years of sales leadership experience managing quota-carrying Account Executives.

• Your own track record as a quota-bearing closer in the mid-marke

description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

The role:

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the team building the Capacity and Quota Management control plane - the system that decides who gets compute, when, and how much.

Idle GPUs are waste. Overallocated ones are a contract you can't keep. Our platform consists of two core components: a capacity reservation engine managing guaranteed GPU reservations and their lifecycle, including rebalancing and auto-reclamation logic; and a Quotas Control Plane that manages quotas across all Nebius services, handles customer quota requests, and runs the algorithms that distribute resources. Both are exposed through APIs that give external customers, internal users, and downstream services visibility and control over their limits.
This is a high-ownership role. You will define how Capacity and Quota Management matures, from the technical foundations to the tradeoffs that outlast any single feature.

The Measurement team within AI Evaluation builds and qualifies the offline scene-understanding models Wayve uses to measure driving performance after on-road runs and in simulation. - Adapt on-vehicle architectures and Wayve foundation models for offline use.

- Collaborate with on-vehicle modelling, evaluation, data curation, and simulation teams.

- Mentor others and contribute to strong machine-learning and engineering practices.

🧩 WHAT YOU’LL BE WORKING ON

- Transformer-based, multimodal, and vision-language models for detection, segmentation, classification, and scene understanding.

- Offline models that use higher compute budgets, larger capacity, and bidirectional temporal context.

- Automated benchmarks that assess coverage, mine rare events, and measure driving behaviour.

- Fleet-scale camera, lidar, and simulation datasets.

- Evidence used in model-development decisions, validation pipelines, customer deliverables, and safety cases.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware-agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution from L2+ through to L4.

title: Senior Help Desk Technician
description:
About ComPsych

ComPsych ® Corporation is the world’s largest provider of mental health services and GuidanceResources® for life. Fueled by a commitment to relentless innovation and a comprehensive approach to care, ComPsych provides services to more than 163 million individuals across 200 countries. Under our GuidanceResources® brand, our personalized and fully integrated programs include behavioral health, absence, and wellness journeys, which empower employees to lead healthier and more productive lives, while driving organizational excellence. Visit compsych.com to find out why 40% of the Fortune 500 choose ComPsych for their mental health needs.
About the Role
At ComPsych , we're evolving our traditional help desk into a modern, AI-enabled Enterprise Technology Services team. AI and automation aren't a productivity add-on bolted onto how support has always worked, they're how we deliver it: we deflect, we self-serve, we automate the repetitive, and we reserve human expertise for the problems that genuinely need it.
This isn't a role for someone who just triages tickets. It's for a senior technician who resolves the problems, builds the automations and knowledge that keep others from having to, and can show the front line got faster and the volume went down. Our platform carries behavioral health data for millions of members, so reliability and security are non-negotiable and are not a tax on speed. Our value isn't the tickets we close, it's the friction we remove for the employees we support.
What You'll Do
You own the hard tickets and the health of the front line, from the device in someone's hands to how quickly and cleanly their issue gets resolved. AI changes where your time goes: less resolving the same ticket twice, more building the automation and knowledge that keep it from coming back.

•
Resolve the escalations others can't. Hardware, software, and procedural issues for internal and external customers over the phone, in person, and through remote connectivity, at Tier 2 / Tier 3 depth.

•
Own the end-user device lifecycle. Deployment, maintenance, and upgrades of desktops, laptops, mobile thin clients, and peripherals across Windows and Mac, and create, deploy, and maintain standardized images, moving toward zero-touch provisioning where possible.

•
Handle identity, access, and connectivity support. File, folder, and account permissions, password resets/unlocks with security-appropriate verification, and network, VPN, and remote-desktop issues across diverse environments.

•
Investigate and document root cause. Don't just fix the symptom, capture the resolution in the ticket system and in reusable knowledge so the front line and self-service can resolve it next time.

•
Reduce toil with automation and self-service. Turn repetitive tickets into scripts, knowledge articles, and self-service so volume goes down, not up, and keep accurate asset inventory and ticket records.

•
Set the standard for the team. Mentor junior technicians, complete inter-office device moves, foster a collaborative environment, and participate in the weekly after-hours on-call rotation.

What We're Looking For

•
You resolve the tickets others escalate, and you make sure they don't come back, going to root cause instead of the quick fix.

•
You're hands-on across the Windows and Mac end-user stack: Windows 11, Microsoft 365, macOS, desktops/laptops/thin clients, imaging, peripherals, and remote-support tooling.

•
You know identity, access, and connectivity support: permissions, password/account management, VPN, and remote desktop in diverse networking environments.

•
You use ITSM tooling well and reduce toil, not just close tickets: experience with ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus or other ITSM solutions like JSM, and you build the automations, images, and knowledge that push volume toward self-service.

title: Senior Principal Engineer, Docker and Ecosystem
description:
ABOUT DOCKER

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

THE OPPORTUNITY

Docker is seeking a Senior Principal Engineer to serve as the technical visionary and architect for how software gets built, verified, and trusted.

Every day, millions of developers pull images, install dependencies, and ship builds to production. Each of those steps is a place where something can go wrong, or be made to go wrong. Compromised base images, malicious packages, tampered build steps, unsigned artifacts moving through pipelines nobody is watching. The industry calls this the software supply chain, and it has become one of the most consequential unsolved problems in software engineering.

This role sits in Docker and Ecosystems, the group that owns Docker’s most well known products and our emerging content and SDLC business. You will own the technical strategy for secure software delivery across all of it, defining what verifiable, tamper-resistant software delivery looks like at Docker's scale, then driving the architecture that makes it real for every developer and every enterprise customer using our products.

You will set multi-year technical direction, make architectural decisions that shape Docker's product portfolio, and work directly with the SVP of Engineering and executive team on strategy. You will not manage people. You will change what the industry considers table stakes.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

TECHNICAL VISION AND STRATEGY

- Lead multi-year technical vision for build security and supply chain across Docker Desktop, Hub, Hardened Images, Verified Publishing, and monetization platforms.

- Define and sequence "trusted by default" architecture for 20M developers.

- Partner with the SVP of Engineering to convert commercial strategy into multi-year technical roadmaps.

- Establish company-wide architectural principles and security standards.

- Identify high-leverage platform investments that enhance security across all Docker products.

- Proactively position architecture ahead of evolving supply chain threats and regulatory demands.

BUILD SECURITY ARCHITECTURE

Architect systems to detect and prevent build-process threats like compromised dependencies, malicious steps, tampered artifacts, and untrusted images.

- Design provenance and attestation infrastructure ensuring Docker artifacts carry verifiable build history.

- Define artifact signing, verification, and policy enforcement across local workflows and CI/CD pipelines.

- Architect SBOM generation, dependency analysis, and vulnerability intelligence for complete software visibility.

- Align with and help shape emerging supply chain security standards.

- Ensure security controls remain fast and unobtrusive so developers keep them enabled.

SDLC AND DEVELOPER WORKFLOW INTEGRATION

- Architect how Docker's security capabilities integrate across the full software development lifecycle, from local development through CI/CD to production deployment

- Design the interfaces and contracts that let Docker's tooling embed into the pipelines, registries, and platforms customers already run, rather than asking them to rebuild around us

- Define the developer experience for security tooling, where the secure path is the fast path and the default path

description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable. As FlixBus continues to expand across India - one of the fastest-growing bus markets in the world - we are looking for a commercially minded Revenue & Monetisation Operations Associate to grow and govern our highway rest stop network.

This is a field-heavy, high-ownership role. You will source and sign new rest stops on active and upcoming corridors, negotiate fixed-fee and revenue-share deals, keep collections and compliance on track, and develop new ways to create value from FlixBus's daily passenger touchpoints. You will report to the Regional Operations Manager and present performance, risks and opportunities to senior leadership.

About the Role

• Identify, evaluate and onboard new highway rest stops on active and upcoming FlixBus corridors, conducting site visits to assess hygiene, footfall, accessibility and brand fit.

• Negotiate fixed-fee and revenue-share agreements with rest stop operators that are commercially sound and build long-term, sustainable partnerships.

• Build and maintain a structured pipeline of prospective stops across North India, South India and new geographies as FlixBus scales.

• Own the full onboarding lifecycle - from first contact to signed agreement, system entry and compliance activation.

• Track monthly collections across all active stops, flag shortfalls early and drive recovery, escalating to bus partner POCs where needed.

• Maintain a clear compliance framework with defined metrics, escalation protocols and partner-level accountability.

title: AI SaaS Product Manager
description:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today’s five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

We are seeking an AI SaaS Product Manager to own the released application portfolio built in-house by the AI & Autonomy division - the AI-powered web, mobile, and spatial applications used daily by manufacturing, satellite operations, analytics, and executive teams, along with AI capabilities delivered to telecom partners. This person is the connective tissue between the engineers who build these applications, the internal customers who depend on them, and the IT organization that helps support them, deciding what ships next based on real usage and ensuring everything that ships is documented, learnable, and supportable. As the organization matures its operational support model for AI applications, this role also supports the Chief of AI and Autonomy in executing the transition roadmap that moves these applications from build-team support into steady-state operations. title: IT Support Engineer (L1/L2)
description:
This is a remote position.
IT Support Engineer (L1/L2)Remote (India) | Full-Time Also searched as: Systems Engineer, System Administrator, Desktop Support Engineer, Service Desk Analyst
Could you keep 425 people working from one Slack queue, and still say no to the wrong access request?
On a typical day you might get a new tutor's Google Workspace, Slack and MFA live before their first class in the morning, work through a campus access point that keeps dropping with the MSP after lunch, and finish by turning today's fix into a knowledge base article the next person can follow.
About Contour
We started in 2020 with a handful of students and a belief that great education should not be out of reach. Today we operate across three brands with 8,000+ students and 425+ team members: roughly 100 in India and 325 onshore in Australia. The India team runs publishing, student experience, CRM and technology, operations, and people and culture.
Most people only notice IT when it stops working. This role is the reason they rarely do.
About This Role
You are the L1 and L2 support engineer for the whole company: the person staff message when something breaks, and the person who fixes most of it. You run the service desk, administer Google Workspace, Slack, HubSpot and the approved AI platforms, look after a fleet of macOS and Windows devices, and support the UniFi network, CCTV and door access across the Melbourne campuses with the local MSP on the ground. You report to the Senior Systems Engineer, who owns architecture, security policy, vendor contracts and any change to how a system is built. Everything at L1 and L2 is yours.
The standard here is different in two specific ways. First, security. Contour holds staff and student data, and most of what goes wrong in IT security goes wrong through a helpful support person granting access nobody checked. When a rushed request for broad access lands, the right move is to slow down and ask what the person needs to do, and you have to be able to do that with a senior manager on the other end. Second, repeat work. The third time you would do a task by hand, you propose the automation instead, and every fix gets written down, because a fix nobody can find is a fix you will do again.
This is a hands-on seat. You take the ticket, fix what you can, and hand up only what needs a senior pair of hands. You are the first dedicated support hire on the offshore technology team, working with that engineer and the Melbourne team, and the team grows around this seat as the company does.
Contour has grown to this size with technology support handled alongside other jobs. This role makes it someone's whole job. By the end of month three you will be working the queue to its response and resolution targets without escalating anything you could have fixed yourself, and running joiner, mover and leaver changes end to end including offboarding. You will have the most common fixes written up in the knowledge base and your first automation proposed. The runbooks you write in those months are the ones the team will still be following in three years.
Where the work lives

• Slack, where the service desk lives:every request goes through the queue. Acknowledge there rather than in a DM, because the queue is the record and the report.

• Google Workspace and the identity platform:accounts, groups, licences and MFA are set to match the role, so a joiner is working on day one and a mover carries nothing across that they should not.

• macOS and Windows devices:enrolment and configuration follow the standard build, so a device is done when it matches the build.

• UniFi:the controller tells you what the network is doing. Read it before you or the MSP touch anything.

• The knowledge base:a fix is finished when it is written up so the next person can follow it without you.

• The password manager:credentials live here and nowhere else.

What You Will Do

• Work the queue.Acknowledge, triage and resolve L1 and L2 requests in the Sl

title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer - Allergan Aesthetics
description:
The Lead Site Reliability Engineer will continuously collaborate with key stakeholders across the business to solve critical technical problems for Allergan Aesthetics. You will be a hands-on technical leader driving reliability, availability, and operational excellence for large-scale public-facing software. As part of the Cloud Platform team, you will own how we measure, protect, and improve production reliability - championing SRE practices, building resilience into our platform, and ensuring our services meet the availability and performance standards our customers expect. You will provide technical thought leadership, mentor engineers across the organization, and turn small ideas into high-fidelity technical game plans that achieve both reliability and business goals.
Reliability Engineering:

• Define and champion SLO/SLI frameworks and error budget-based decision making to drive prioritization between reliability and feature work.

• Own observability strategy across services - metrics, logs, traces, and alerting - ensuring signals are actionable and tied to user impact.

• Lead capacity planning, load testing, and resilience/chaos testing for critical public-facing services.

• Establish production readiness reviews and partner with development teams to improve services through rigorous testing and release procedures.

• Identify and eliminate toil through automation, self-healing systems, and improved observability.

• Gather and analyze metrics from operating systems and applications to drive performance tuning and fault finding.

• Contribute reliability improvements to the platform through infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and Kubernetes configuration, working within Cloud Platform team standards.

Incident Management & Response:

• Own and evolve the incident response process, including severity definitions, escalation paths, and postmortem practice.

• Participate in on-call rotations and provide hands-on support during incidents with appropriate urgency.

• Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure and application issues, driving blameless root cause analysis and tracking corrective actions to completion.

Standards & Architecture:

• Champion reliability, scalability, and security standards across AA Tech services and the AA Tech product platform.

• Partner and inform strategic architecture decisions for new services and major platform changes for reliability risks (failure modes, redundancy, scaling limits, alerting) before launch as part of Cloud Platform design reviews.

• Define and maintain reliability standards (e.g., SLO coverage, alerting, runbooks, backup and recovery requirements) and track how services meet them

• Stay current with the latest trends in site/service reliability practices and tooling. Identify proven technologies and solutions for emerging challenges.

Technical Mentorship:

• Provide technical mentorship and guidance to senior-level DevOps and Software Engineers utilizing proven design patterns and experience building large-scale public-facing software.

• Foster a culture of operational excellence, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning across the engineering organization.

• Provide technical thought leadership to implement strategic architecture, systems, and projects on the roadmap.

• Proven track record running SLO/error budget programs and incident management for large-scale production systems.

• Deep experience with observability platforms (e.g., Datadog) and alert design.

• Working proficiency with Terraform and Kubernetes on AWS; comfortable reading, reviewing, and contributing infrastructure code.

• Strong scripting/programming skills (e.g., Python, Go) for automation and tooling.

Preferred:

• Hands-on experience using or building agentic AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, MCP-based integrations) to automate engineering or operational workflows, with appropriate guardrails and human oversight.
Applicable only to applicants applying to a position in any location with pay

title: Senior Product Information Specialist
SAP ChaRM Specialist
description:
This is a remote position.
We are looking for a hands-on SAP Operations / ALM specialist to lead and operate change control, test management and solution documentation activities across SAP landscapes. This is not a generic SolMan consultant role - the candidate must have deep, demonstrable experience with ChaRM, Test Workbench and maintaining solution documentation in SAP Solution Manager. The role will support release cycles, ensure quality gates are met and keep system documentation accurate and audit-ready. Main Responsibilities

• Operate and govern ChaRM processes: ticket lifecycle, transport orchestration, approvals, emergency fixes and release management.

• Configure and operate Change Request Management workflows (including CTS+, transport routes and landscape handling).

• Manage and run Test Workbench: design test plans, create and maintain test cases, execute test runs, manage test cycles and report results.

• Maintain and author solution documentation: technical and functional documentation in Solution Documentation, building and updating requirements-to-implementation traceability.

• Coordinate with development, basis, DBA and infrastructure teams to ensure transports are applied safely and rollbacks are planned.

• Support release and cutover activities, drive quality gates and readiness checks.

• Implement and improve ALM processes and automation where possible (integration with CI/CD, automated test triggers, test data management).

• Produce test and release artefacts for audits and compliance (SOX, regulatory as required).

• Troubleshoot ChaRM/Test Workbench issues, drive root-cause analysis and preventative measures.

• Train and coach application teams and support staff on ChaRM and Test Workbench best practices.

Requirements

• Minimum 4-6 years hands-on experience with SAP Solution Manager (7.1 / 7.2) in production environments.

• Proven deep experience operating ChaRM / Change Request Management and transport management (CTS/CTS+).

• Strong knowledge of Test Workbench: test plan creation, test case management, test execution and results reporting.

• Practical experience with Solution Documentation: creating process maps, building requirement links and maintaining implementation documentation.

• Good understanding of SAP landscape topologies and transport routes across DEV / QA / PROD.

• Experience supporting SAP releases and cutovers; familiarity with emergency transport handling.

• Basic knowledge of ABAP or ability to read transport logs and coordinate with developers.

• Experience with integration between Solution Manager and ALM/CI tools (Jira, Git, Jenkins) is a plus.

• Familiar with audit/compliance needs: ability to prepare artefacts and evidence for audits.

• Solid problem-solving skills and demonstrable track record of reducing rework and failed transports.

Behavioural / soft skills

• Clear, structured communicator able to work with technical teams and business stakeholders.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail; disciplined about runbooks and documentation.

• Proactive, takes ownership of incidents and release issues.

• Comfortable working in 24/7-support environments and participating in on-call rotations if required.

• English fluency; local language as required by the assignment.

Nice to have

• Experience with Focused Build / Focused Run.

• Knowledge of automated testing tools integrated with Solution Manager (eCATT, CBTA, or third-party test automation).

• Exposure to cloud-hosted SAP landscapes (HANA, S/4HANA migrations).

• Experience with SAP Transport Management Tooling and third-party transport orchestration.

Benefits

• Fully remote work model

• Mentorship - work closely with experienced engineers in a high-impact environment

• International project - cybersecurity domain with real-world impact​

This role is for a position at WISEcode labs, WISEcode's sister company and an independent third party testing lab. 
--
WISEcode Labs, formerly Beaconpoint Labs, was built out of necessity.
The laboratory was created to support its sister company WISEcode and its Food Genome Project™, an ambitious effort to build a comprehensive food and ingredient intelligence platform. In pursuing that goal, it became clear that the required testing capabilities simply did not exist. No laboratory could reliably deliver the breadth, depth, speed, and transparency needed to analyze thousands of ingredients across hundreds of analytes with confidence. Rather than compromise, the lab was built to solve that problem properly.
WISEcode Labs is an independent third-party testing laboratory serving food, beverage, dietary supplement, ingredient, and adjacent consumer-health companies. The lab combines advanced analytical instrumentation, rigorous method development, microbiology and chemistry expertise, and a high-touch service model designed for customers with complex and recurring testing needs.
WISEcode Labs is differentiated by its unwavering focus on food safety and nutrition testing and becoming a primary testing partner to key customers, owing to its rapid response time and direct access to scientific leaders, customized solutions, and defensible data.
Effective August 25th 2026, the company unified its brand with its sister company under a single name: WISEcode Labs. The next phase is to scale this platform without losing the quality, speed, independence, confidentiality, and accountability on which the business was built to be the preferred testing & scientific partner for the food industry and WISEcode’s mission towards food transparency.
